caption: The drawing depicts an open round box with a hinged lid, shown from a top-down perspective on a plain, light beige background. The lid, which is positioned above the box, has an inscription inside that reads, “I present this to X as a trifling mark of my Esteem,” written in a cursive script within an outlined border. The interior of the lid is pale blue with a subtle reflective quality. Below the lid, the open box reveals a similar pale blue interior, also reflecting light, with some shading to indicate depth. The outside of the round box is light pink. The clasp and hinge connecting the lid to the box are small and rendered in a muted yellow or brass-like tone. The objects are arranged vertically, with the lid directly above the open box, and they are centrally placed on the mostly empty sheet.
title: Epaulette Box
